    97→local MeshBin = {}

   100→function MeshBin.new()
   101→	return setmetatable({chunks = {}, active = {}}, MeshBin)
   102→end
   103→
   104→function MeshBin:getBucket(key, addVertCount)
   105→	addVertCount = addVertCount or 0
   106→	local b = self.active[key]
   107→	if (not b) or (#b.vs + addVertCount > 24000) then
   108→		b = {matKey = key, vs = {}, ns = {}, uvs = {}, fs = {}}
   109→		self.active[key] = b
   110→		self.chunks[#self.chunks + 1] = b
   111→	end
   112→	return b
   113→end

   115→function MeshBin:addRaw(key, v_list, f_list, hardCrease, uvScale)
   116→	local estVerts = hardCrease and (#f_list * 3) or #v_list
   117→	local b = self:getBucket(key, estVerts)
   118→	uvScale = uvScale or 10.0
   119→	if hardCrease then
   120→		for _, tri in ipairs(f_list) do
   121→			local p1, p2, p3 = v_list[tri[1]], v_list[tri[2]], v_list[tri[3]]
   122→			local s1 = toStudioPos(p1[1], p1[2], p1[3])
   123→			local s2 = toStudioPos(p2[1], p2[2], p2[3])
   124→			local s3 = toStudioPos(p3[1], p3[2], p3[3])
   125→			local cr = (s2 - s1):Cross(s3 - s1)
   126→			if cr.Magnitude > 1e-7 then
   127→				local nrm = cr.Unit
   128→				local base = #b.vs
   129→				b.vs[base + 1] = s1; b.vs[base + 2] = s2; b.vs[base + 3] = s3
   130→				b.ns[base + 1] = nrm; b.ns[base + 2] = nrm; b.ns[base + 3] = nrm
   131→				b.uvs[base + 1] = Vector2.new((p1[1] + p1[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p1[3] + p1[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   132→				b.uvs[base + 2] = Vector2.new((p2[1] + p2[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p2[3] + p2[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   133→				b.uvs[base + 3] = Vector2.new((p3[1] + p3[2] * 0.5) / uvScale, (p3[3] + p3[2] * 0.3) / uvScale)
   134→				b.fs[#b.fs + 1] = {base + 1, base + 2, base + 3}
   135→			end
   136→		end
   137→	else
   138→		local base = #b.vs
   139→		local accN = table.create(#v_list, Vector3.zero)
   140→		local stV = table.create(#v_list)
   141→		for i, p in ipairs(v_list) do
   142→			stV[i] = toStudioPos(p[1], p[2], p[3])
   143→		end
   144→		for _, tri in ipairs(f_list) do
   145→			local i1, i2, i3 = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
   146→			local cr = (stV[i2] - stV[i1]):Cross(stV[i3] - stV[i1])
   147→			if cr.Magnitude > 1e-7 then
   148→				accN[i1] += cr; accN[i2] += cr; accN[i3] += cr
   149→				b.fs[#b.fs + 1] = {base + i1, base + i2, base + i3}
   150→			end
   151→		end
   152→		for i, p in ipairs(v_list) do
   153→			b.vs[base + i] = stV[i]
   154→			local nm = accN[i]
   155→			b.ns[base + i] = nm.Magnitude > 1e-7 and nm.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
   156→			b.uvs[base + i] = Vector2.new((p[1] + 25.0) / uvScale, (p[3] + 22.0) / uvScale)
   157→		end
   158→	end
   159→end

   161→function MeshBin:box(key, cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, rotCF)
   162→	local hx, hy, hz = sx * 0.5, sy * 0.5, sz * 0.5
   163→	local corners = {
   164→		{-hx, -hy, -hz}, { hx, -hy, -hz}, { hx,  hy, -hz}, {-hx,  hy, -hz},
   165→		{-hx, -hy,  hz}, { hx, -hy,  hz}, { hx,  hy,  hz}, {-hx,  hy,  hz},
   166→	}
   167→	local vs = {}
   168→	for i, c in ipairs(corners) do
   169→		if rotCF then
   170→			local p = rotCF:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(c[1], c[2], c[3]))
   171→			vs[i] = {cx + p.X, cy + p.Y, cz + p.Z}
   172→		else
   173→			vs[i] = {cx + c[1], cy + c[2], cz + c[3]}
   174→		end
   175→	end
   176→	local fs = {
   177→		{1, 3, 2}, {1, 4, 3}, {5, 6, 7}, {5, 7, 8},
   178→		{1, 2, 6}, {1, 6, 5}, {2, 3, 7}, {2, 7, 6},
   179→		{3, 4, 8}, {3, 8, 7}, {4, 1, 5}, {4, 5, 8},
   180→	}
   181→	self:addRaw(key, vs, fs, true, 10.0)
   182→end

   184→-- Yalnızca cıvata pimleri, korkuluk çubukları ve manometre gövdesi için dolu çubuk/disk
   185→function MeshBin:cylVec(key, aVec, bVec, r, segs, hard, capped)
   186→	local dx, dy, dz = bVec.X - aVec.X, bVec.Y - aVec.Y, bVec.Z - aVec.Z
   187→	local L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
   188→	if L < 1e-4 then return end
   189→	local fwd = Vector3.new(dx / L, dy / L, dz / L)
   190→	local ref = math.abs(fwd.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   191→	local uAx = fwd:Cross(ref).Unit
   192→	local vAx = fwd:Cross(uAx).Unit
   193→	local vs, fs = {}, {}
   194→	for ring = 0, 1 do
   195→		local o = ring == 0 and aVec or bVec
   196→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   197→			local th = 2 * math.pi * j / segs
   198→			local p = uAx * (math.cos(th) * r) + vAx * (math.sin(th) * r)
   199→			vs[#vs + 1] = {o.X + p.X, o.Y + p.Y, o.Z + p.Z}
   200→		end
   201→	end
   202→	for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   203→		local k = (j + 1) % segs
   204→		local a, b, c, d = j + 1, k + 1, segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   205→		fs[#fs + 1] = {a, b, d}; fs[#fs + 1] = {a, d, c}
   206→	end
   207→	self:addRaw(key, vs, fs, hard == true, 8.0)
   208→	if capped ~= false then
   209→		local cap0, cap1, cf0, cf1 = {{aVec.X, aVec.Y, aVec.Z}}, {{bVec.X, bVec.Y, bVec.Z}}, {}, {}
   210→		for j = 1, segs do
   211→			cap0[j + 1] = vs[j]
   212→			cap1[j + 1] = vs[segs + j]
   213→		end
   214→		for j = 1, segs do
   215→			local k = (j % segs) + 1
   216→			cf0[#cf0 + 1] = {1, k + 1, j + 1}
   217→			cf1[#cf1 + 1] = {1, j + 1, k + 1}
   218→		end
   219→		self:addRaw(key, cap0, cf0, true, 8.0)
   220→		self:addRaw(key, cap1, cf1, true, 8.0)
   221→	end
   222→end

   224→function MeshBin:cyl(key, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, r, segs, hard)
   225→	self:cylVec(key, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az), Vector3.new(bx, by, bz), r, segs or 12, hard, true)
   226→end

   228→-- GERÇEK İÇİ DELİK (ET KALINLIKLI) ENDÜSTRİYEL BORU PRİMİTİFİ!
   229→-- Dış yüzey (keyOuter, rOut) + İç delik yüzey (keyInner, rIn) + İki uçta halka et kalınlığı!
   230→function MeshBin:hollowPipeVec(keyOuter, aVec, bVec, rOut, rIn, segs, ringStart, ringEnd, keyInner)
   231→	local dx, dy, dz = bVec.X - aVec.X, bVec.Y - aVec.Y, bVec.Z - aVec.Z
   232→	local L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
   233→	if L < 1e-4 then return end
   234→	segs = segs or 16
   235→	rIn = rIn or (rOut * 0.72)
   236→	keyInner = keyInner or "pipe_bore"
   237→	local fwd = Vector3.new(dx / L, dy / L, dz / L)
   238→	local ref = math.abs(fwd.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   239→	local uAx = fwd:Cross(ref).Unit
   240→	local vAx = fwd:Cross(uAx).Unit
   241→
   242→	local vOut, fOut = {}, {}
   243→	local vIn,  fIn  = {}, {}
   244→	for ring = 0, 1 do
   245→		local o = ring == 0 and aVec or bVec
   246→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   247→			local th = 2 * math.pi * j / segs
   248→			local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
   249→			local pO = uAx * (cs * rOut) + vAx * (sn * rOut)
   250→			local pI = uAx * (cs * rIn)  + vAx * (sn * rIn)
   251→			vOut[#vOut + 1] = {o.X + pO.X, o.Y + pO.Y, o.Z + pO.Z}
   252→			vIn[#vIn + 1]   = {o.X + pI.X, o.Y + pI.Y, o.Z + pI.Z}
   253→		end
   254→	end
   255→	for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   256→		local k = (j + 1) % segs
   257→		local a, b, c, d = j + 1, k + 1, segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   258→		fOut[#fOut + 1] = {a, b, d}; fOut[#fOut + 1] = {a, d, c}
   259→		-- İç cidar normalleri merkeze bakar!
   260→		fIn[#fIn + 1]   = {a, d, b}; fIn[#fIn + 1]   = {a, c, d}
   261→	end
   262→	self:addRaw(keyOuter, vOut, fOut, false, 8.0)
   263→	self:addRaw(keyInner, vIn,  fIn,  false, 8.0)
   264→
   265→	if ringStart ~= false then
   266→		local vr, fr = {}, {}
   267→		for j = 1, segs do
   268→			vr[j] = vOut[j]
   269→			vr[segs + j] = vIn[j]
   270→		end
   271→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   272→			local k = (j + 1) % segs
   273→			local o0, o1 = j + 1, k + 1
   274→			local i0, i1 = segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   275→			fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, i1, o1}; fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, i0, i1}
   276→		end
   277→		self:addRaw(keyOuter, vr, fr, true, 8.0)
   278→	end
   279→	if ringEnd ~= false then
   280→		local vr, fr = {}, {}
   281→		for j = 1, segs do
   282→			vr[j] = vOut[segs + j]
   283→			vr[segs + j] = vIn[segs + j]
   284→		end
   285→		for j = 0, segs - 1 do
   286→			local k = (j + 1) % segs
   287→			local o0, o1 = j + 1, k + 1
   288→			local i0, i1 = segs + j + 1, segs + k + 1
   289→			fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, o1, i1}; fr[#fr + 1] = {o0, i1, i0}
   290→		end
   291→		self:addRaw(keyOuter, vr, fr, true, 8.0)
   292→	end
   293→end

   295→function MeshBin:hollowPipe(keyOuter, ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, rOut, rIn, segs, ringStart, ringEnd)
   296→	self:hollowPipeVec(keyOuter, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az), Vector3.new(bx, by, bz), rOut, rIn, segs or 16, ringStart, ringEnd)
   297→end

   299→local function alignAxisBasis(axisVec)
   300→	local zt = axisVec.Unit
   301→	local up = math.abs(zt.Z) < 0.92 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.xAxis
   302→	local xa = up:Cross(zt).Unit
   303→	local ya = zt:Cross(xa).Unit
   304→	return xa, ya, zt
   305→end

   307→-- GERÇEK ORTASI AÇIK (DELİKLİ) ANSI BORU FLANŞI!
   308→-- Dış etrafı saran yakalı halka (rInner = pipeR * 0.99 -> borunun kendi pipe_bore cidarıyla %0 eş-düzlemli çakışma!)
   309→function MeshBin:hollowFlange(centerVec, axisVec, pipeR, bolts, _rIn)
   310→	bolts = bolts or 8
   311→	local rWrap = pipeR * 0.992
   312→	local xa, ya, zt = alignAxisBasis(axisVec)
   313→	local flR = pipeR * 1.46 + 0.08
   314→	local flT = math.max(0.14, pipeR * 0.28)
   315→	self:hollowPipeVec("flange", centerVec - zt * (flT * 0.46), centerVec + zt * (flT * 0.46), flR, pipeR * 1.18 + 0.04, 18, true, true, "gunmetal")
   316→	self:hollowPipeVec("gunmetal", centerVec - zt * (flT * 0.92), centerVec + zt * (flT * 0.92), pipeR * 1.16 + 0.03, rWrap, 16, true, true, "gunmetal")
   317→	local boltR = pipeR + 0.62 * (flR - pipeR)
   318→	local bRad = math.max(0.035, pipeR * 0.075)
   319→	for bi = 0, bolts - 1 do
   320→		local ang = 2 * math.pi * bi / bolts
   321→		local wp = centerVec + xa * (boltR * math.cos(ang)) + ya * (boltR * math.sin(ang))
   322→		self:cylVec("clamp", wp - zt * (flT * 0.85), wp + zt * (flT * 0.85), bRad, 6, true, true)
   323→	end
   324→end

   326→-- GERÇEK İÇİ DELİK 90° SÜPÜRMELİ BORU DİRSEĞİ!
   327→function MeshBin:hollowElbow90(matKey, cornerVec, dirIn, dirOut, bendR, pipeR, segs, flanged)
   328→	segs = segs or 7
   329→	local rIn = pipeR * 0.72
   330→	local uIn = dirIn.Unit
   331→	local uOut = dirOut.Unit
   332→	local pStart = cornerVec - uIn * bendR
   333→	local pEnd = cornerVec + uOut * bendR
   334→	local cArc = cornerVec - uIn * bendR + uOut * bendR
   335→	local e1 = pStart - cArc
   336→	local e2 = pEnd - cArc
   337→	local pts = {}
   338→	for i = 0, segs do
   339→		local th = 0.5 * math.pi * (i / segs)
   340→		pts[i + 1] = cArc + e1 * math.cos(th) + e2 * math.sin(th)
   341→	end
   342→	for i = 1, segs do
   343→		local a = pts[i]
   344→		local b = pts[i + 1]
   345→		local dir = (b - a).Unit
   346→		self:hollowPipeVec(matKey, a - dir * (pipeR * 0.09), b + dir * (pipeR * 0.09), pipeR * 1.005, rIn, 14, i == 1, i == segs, "pipe_bore")
   347→	end
   348→	if flanged ~= false then
   349→		self:hollowFlange(pStart, uIn, pipeR, 8, rIn)
   350→		self:hollowFlange(pEnd, uOut, pipeR, 8, rIn)
   351→	end
   352→	return pStart, pEnd
   353→end

   355→function MeshBin:handwheelValve(posVec, pipeAxis, wheelDir, pipeR)
   356→	local pa = pipeAxis.Unit
   357→	local wd = wheelDir.Unit
   358→	local rIn = pipeR * 0.72

   391→function MeshBin:emitToModel(parentModel, namePrefix, collide)
   392→	local jobs = {}
   393→	for idx, b in ipairs(self.chunks) do

   395→			jobs[#jobs + 1] = {idx = idx, b = b}
   396→		end

   399→	local BATCH = 10
   400→	local jIdx = 1
   401→	while jIdx <= #jobs do
   402→		local bEnd = math.min(#jobs, jIdx + BATCH - 1)
   403→		local remaining = bEnd - jIdx + 1
   404→		local caller = coroutine.running()
   405→		local resumed = false
   406→		for k = jIdx, bEnd do
   407→			local item = jobs[k]
   408→			task.spawn(function()
   409→				local okRun, errRun = pcall(function()
   410→					local idx, b = item.idx, item.b
   411→					local key = b.matKey
   412→					local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
   413→					local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
   414→					for _, v in ipairs(b.vs) do
   415→						if v.X < minX then minX = v.X end; if v.X > maxX then maxX = v.X end
   416→						if v.Y < minY then minY = v.Y end; if v.Y > maxY then maxY = v.Y end
   417→						if v.Z < minZ then minZ = v.Z end; if v.Z > maxZ then maxZ = v.Z end
   418→					end
   419→					local center = Vector3.new((minX + maxX) * 0.5, (minY + maxY) * 0.5, (minZ + maxZ) * 0.5)
   420→					local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
   421→					local vids = table.create(#b.vs)
   422→					local nids = table.create(#b.vs)
   423→					local uvids = table.create(#b.vs)
   424→					for i = 1, #b.vs do
   425→						vids[i] = em:AddVertex(b.vs[i] - center)
   426→						nids[i] = em:AddNormal(b.ns[i])
   427→						uvids[i] = em:AddUV(b.uvs[i])
   428→					end
   429→					for _, tri in ipairs(b.fs) do
   430→						local i1, i2, i3 = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
   431→						local fid = em:AddTriangle(vids[i1], vids[i2], vids[i3])
   432→						em:SetFaceNormals(fid, {nids[i1], nids[i2], nids[i3]})
   433→						em:SetFaceUVs(fid, {uvids[i1], uvids[i2], uvids[i3]})
   434→					end
   435→					local ok, st, content = pcall(function()
   436→						return AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
   437→					end)
   438→					local mp
   439→					if ok and st == Enum.CreateContentResult.Success and content then
   440→						pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
   441→						mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(content)
   442→					else
   443→						mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
   444→						pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
   445→					end
   446→					mp.Name = string.format("%s__%s_%02d", namePrefix, key, idx)
   447→					mp.Anchored = true
   448→					mp.CanCollide = collide == true
   449→					mp.CanTouch = false
   450→					mp.CanQuery = false
   451→					mp.CastShadow = not NON_SHADOW[key]
   452→					mp.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
   453→					applyMat(mp, key)
   454→					mp.Parent = parentModel
   455→					created += 1
   456→					emittedCount += 1
   457→				end)
   458→				if not okRun then warn("[FAZ3] emit err:", errRun) end
   459→				remaining -= 1
   460→				if remaining == 0 and not resumed then
   461→					resumed = true
   462→					task.spawn(caller)
   463→				end
   464→			end)
   465→		end
   466→		if remaining > 0 and not resumed then
   467→			coroutine.yield()
   468→		end
   469→		jIdx = bEnd + 1
   470→	end
   471→	return created
   472→end
